metadata.description: OSM road-following driving alignments for academic fiber planning. Not surveyed fiber corridors; paved surface and build rights unverified.
metadata.distance_method: OSRM fastest driving route distance (meters / 1000), without terrain detour multiplier.
metadata.capex_method: OSRM road kilometers × modeled USD/km terrain rate; not a cable construction quote.
